causal_account.statement: This partition is a single, pure snapshot-divergence block. Not one of the 42 rows is wrong at its own era: every quoted value resolves exactly, at the quoted precision, against its anchor as it stood at the document's own commit. The divergence is entirely artefact-side and was produced by three successive movements, ALL of which postdate the documents' last commit (6b64ad0f6, 2026-05-03T01:24:43Z): (1) the 2026-05-03T02:01-02:45Z recovery propagation for the image, text-MIN and GS-v2 runs, which the documents' own post-recovery banners could not cover because those banners were written 37-81 minutes EARLIER and are scoped exclusively to the text-HIGH recovery; (2) the 2026-06-12 audited-flex cost-manifest regeneration (8e142df9c), which overwrote every launcher-recorded totals.cost_usd in place at the same locator; (3) the 2026-08-03 corrected-F1 de-dup regeneration (3271d6923 / 30a902f56), which is this verification programme's own W6-E9 fix chain. The documents have not been touched since 2026-05-03; the artefacts have moved three times.
causal_account.the_partial_refresh_mechanism: The banners are ruling-17 partial-refresh residue in its purest form. On 2026-05-03 the maintainer propagated the text-HIGH recovery into all three documents (6b64ad0f6) and then, within the next 80 minutes, ran the image / text-MIN / GS-v2 recoveries (c1ea6df3c 02:01Z, 236327d80 02:10Z, a78cd7c55 02:28Z, da84a3d23 02:30Z, 8699f456b 02:45Z, c60230347) without a second documentation pass. That timing gap - not any authorial error - is why the anchor table's text-HIGH row carries a banner and its image and text-MIN rows do not, and why the image F1 (0.771 -> 0.7745), image D-S (0.7954 -> 0.799), text-MIN F1 (0.7591 -> 0.7619), ds-human-crosstab (0.186207 -> 0.18651; ECE 0.5385007 -> 0.5384655), multi-buffer corrected F1 and subtype weighted F1 all sit un-annotated in these documents to this day.
causal_account.falsification_test: Produce ANY row in this partition whose quoted value fails to equal, at the quoted number of decimal places, the anchor resolved by `git show c48f639e3:<path>` (body rows) or `git show 6b64ad0f6:<path>` (banner rows). I resolved all nine anchor artefacts at both commits and found zero such rows. A single counterexample refutes the account. Secondary falsifier: show an artefact commit that moved one of these nine anchors BETWEEN c48f639e3 and 6b64ad0f6 in a way that makes a body row unfaithful at the banner era - I found only one anchor that moved in that window (the text-high manifest, 69.6017 -> 126.8051), and the extraction already routes the two figures to separate values.
